record.paper_title: Some Open Problems in Quantum Information Theory
record.original_question: For the entanglement of formation EF, defined as the infimum over convex decompositions of a bipartite density operator into states of the average von Neumann entropy of Alice’s reduced state, does tensor-product additivity always hold? That is, for any two bipartite density operators rho^(1) and rho^(2), when their tensor product is viewed as a bipartite state by grouping Alice’s two systems and Bob’s two systems, is EF(rho^(1) tensor rho^(2)) always equal to EF(rho^(1)) + EF(rho^(2))?

evidence.quote: The entanglement of formation [BD96] is one of the standard measures of entanglement. It is defined, for any density operator ρ on a bipartite system, as EF(ρ) = inf (Σi ri S(ρi|A) | Σi riρi = ρ), where S(.) denotes the von Neumann entropy and ρ|A denotes the restriction of a density operator ρ to the “Alice” subsystem (partial trace over the other subsystem), the ρi are density operators and the ri are positive, adding up to one.

Then it is easy to show (by plugging the tensor product of the optimal decompositions of the factors into the variational expression and using the additivity of the entropy) that EF(ρ) ≤ EF(ρ(1)) + EF(ρ(2)).
The problem is to show that equality always holds here.
This problem has been shown to be equivalent to problem 10.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mathcal{H}_A$ and $\mathcal{H}_B$ be finite-dimensional complex Hilbert spaces, and let $\rho$ be a density operator on the bipartite system $\mathcal{H}_A\otimes\mathcal{H}_B$. Define the entanglement of formation of $\rho$ by
$$E_F(\rho)=\inf\Big\{\sum_i r_i\, S(\mathrm{Tr}_B|\psi_i\rangle\langle\psi_i|)\ :\ \rho=\sum_i r_i|\psi_i\rangle\langle\psi_i|,\ r_i\ge 0,\ \sum_i r_i=1\Big\},$$
where the infimum runs over all convex decompositions of $\rho$ into pure states $|\psi_i\rangle\langle\psi_i|$ on $\mathcal{H}_A\otimes\mathcal{H}_B$, and $S(\sigma)=-\mathrm{Tr}(\sigma\log\sigma)$ denotes the von Neumann entropy.

Given two bipartite density operators $\rho^{(1)}$ on $\mathcal{H}_{A_1}\otimes\mathcal{H}_{B_1}$ and $\rho^{(2)}$ on $\mathcal{H}_{A_2}\otimes\mathcal{H}_{B_2}$, regard $\rho^{(1)}\otimes\rho^{(2)}$ as a bipartite state with Alice's system $\mathcal{H}_{A_1}\otimes\mathcal{H}_{A_2}$ and Bob's system $\mathcal{H}_{B_1}\otimes\mathcal{H}_{B_2}$. It is straightforward to show
$$E_F(\rho^{(1)}\otimes\rho^{(2)})\ \le\ E_F(\rho^{(1)})+E_F(\rho^{(2)}).$$
Decide whether equality always holds: is it true that for all such $\rho^{(1)}$ and $\rho^{(2)}$,
$$E_F(\rho^{(1)}\otimes\rho^{(2)})\ =\ E_F(\rho^{(1)})+E_F(\rho^{(2)})\ ?$$
artifact.status_search_result: The additivity question for entanglement of formation has been resolved negatively. By Shor's equivalence (2004), additivity of $E_F$ is equivalent to additivity of the minimum output entropy and Holevo capacity of quantum channels. Hastings (2009) constructed random-unitary channel counterexamples disproving additivity of minimum output entropy, which by the equivalence implies that $E_F$ is not additive in general: there exist bipartite states with $E_F(\rho^{(1)}\otimes\rho^{(2)}) < E_F(\rho^{(1)}) + E_F(\rho^{(2)})$. Subsequent works (Aubrun–Szarek–Werner; King; Fukuda–King–Moser) clarified and simplified the construction.

status_evidence.title: Superadditivity of communication capacity using entangled inputs (Hastings)
status_evidence.snippet: Hastings constructs a counterexample to the additivity of minimum output entropy, equivalent to non-additivity of entanglement of formation.
status_evidence.claim: Hastings disproved the additivity conjectures, implying non-additivity of E_F.

status_evidence.title: Hastings's Additivity Counterexample via Dvoretzky's Theorem
status_evidence.snippet: Provides a simplified proof of Hastings's counterexample to additivity using Dvoretzky's theorem.
status_evidence.claim: The additivity conjectures (including additivity of entanglement of formation) are false.

status_evidence.title: Comments on Hastings' Additivity Counterexamples (King)
status_evidence.snippet: Clarifies and extends Hastings's counterexample to additivity.
status_evidence.claim: Additivity of minimum output entropy fails, hence so does additivity of E_F via Shor's equivalence.
